question: Where is the World Heritage Site, Konark Sun Temple situated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Konark Sun Temple **is a 13th-century Hindu temple dedicated to the sun god Surya.
 
• It is located in Konark, a town in the Puri district of Odisha, India.
 
• The temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is one of the most popular tourist destinations in India.
 
• Sun Temple of Konark was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty about 1250 CE.
 
• This temple is dedicated to the Hindu god Surya and located 35 km northeast from Puri.
